summary: Realty Income Corporation filed an 8-K to report entry into a sales agreement (an at-the-market offering program) for up to 150,000,000 shares of its common stock, with multiple agents including Baird, Barclays, and Goldman Sachs. The company acts as issuer; no merger, tender, or acquisition event. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation. There are no stated transaction price, premium, or structural conditions beyond the ATM facility. The filing is an ordinary current report without any transformative event warranting classification under the defined special-situations categories.
